messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency spike detected for streaming routes in eu-west-1. Metric: streaming.p99 = 3.2s (SLO 1.0s). Error increase: stream stalls +12% in last 5m. Related deploy: quant-calib/2026-03-15@22:47 

sasha_ops: I'm on it. Noting recent precision-profile rollout for vicuna-13b-int8 in eu pools ~22:47. Rolling changes might correlate.

mike_oncall: seeing similar trend on dashboards. p95 also creeping to ~1.1s. Any customer-facing impact yet?

jess_support: CS queue: two customers reported streaming timeouts and slow generation. Ticket INC-1209 and INC-1210. Behavior: stall at ~token 512, then partial stream resumes or times out.

eva_sre: grabbing logs. Filtered trace from router: ``stream_handler: recv loop blocked for 1450ms, kv-cache miss spikes, dequantize latency sample: 880ms``. Looks like dequant path in int8 variant.

liam_infra: resource view: GPU utilization normal, no obvious saturation. Memory OK. but node-level CPU on worker proxies spiking during dequant calls.

sasha_ops: hypothesis: calibration patch for int8 changed fallback thresholds causing heavier dequant work / cache churn for long contexts. Could increase tail latency.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) route streaming requests to fp16 variant for eu-west-1 via routing rule, 2) pause the int8 precision-profile rollout, 3) open canary to eu-west-2 only. Agreed?

eva_sre: agree. Add step: disable prefix KV caching for int8 models until we confirm dequant path. That will increase tokens but may reduce per-request stalls.

sasha_ops: executing step 2: ``redwoodctl models profile pause --name=quant-calib-2026-03-15 --region=eu-west-1``

deploy-bot: deploy event: rollback request received by sasha_ops for quant-calib-2026-03-15 -> state: pausing rollout. CI check passed.

liam_infra: applying routing override: ``redwoodctl routing set --match=route:streaming --region=eu-west-1 --model=vicuna-13b-fp16 --priority=force``

sasha_ops: routing override applied. Monitor switch now.

mike_oncall: dashboards show p99 dropping to ~1.4s within 60s of override. p95 back under 1s. Good sign.

jess_support: letting impacted customers know: sending interim note that we're mitigating and will follow up within 30m.

eva_sre: tracing shows dequant hot path calls reduce by ~85% after routing to fp16. Remaining p99 ~1.2s likely due to pending backlog.

sasha_ops: next steps: 1) keep int8 paused in eu-west-1, 2) run calibration repro on staging with long-context prompts, 3) open regression eval against our streaming set, 4) prepare a safe re-roll plan with conservative fallback thresholds.

mike_oncall: can we do a hotfix instead of full rollback? e.g., tweak dequant batch size or increase dequant worker threads?

liam_infra: we can hotpatch the dequant config but that requires a new build and a small restart on workers. Given customer impact, routing -> fp16 + paused rollout is lower-risk for now. We'll schedule hotpatch during the 2h window if p99 doesn't fully normalize.

eva_sre: created log snippet for postmortem: ``ERR[22:53:07] dequant: slow_call token_idx=512 latency=912ms model=vicuna-13b-int8 calib_version=2026-03-15``. Saving spans to /artifacts/4298760000/spans.tar.gz

sasha_ops: tagging incident for postmortem: "quant-calib-eu-tail-surge". Assigning owners: SRE = eva_sre, Runtime = sasha_ops, Infra = liam_infra, Support = jess_support.

jess_support: CS update sent. Customers asked for ETA; told them 2-4 hours for full root cause and workaround note.

mike_oncall: escalation: if p99 > 1.5s in next 30m, page infra lead. current last check OK.

sasha_ops: summary (for handoff): rolled back/paused calibration rollout in eu-west-1, forced routing to fp16, monitoring. Recommendation: do not resume int8 until repro case passes regression eval and KV-cache interplay tested for long streams.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=SEV3, status=mitigated-by-routing, created=4298760000, updated=4298761180. Links: dashboard://streams/eu-west-1, logs://query?tag=4298760000

eva_sre: leaving follow-up tasks in the incident board: reproduce with 2x long-context prompts, run profile diff int8 v2026-03-01 -> v2026-03-15, run load test with KV-cache enabled.

mike_oncall: handing off to night shift: @liam_infra will watch for any re-emergence. Oncall rotations tagged. Good job team :white_check_mark: 

liam_infra: I'll keep an eye and will kick off hotpatch plan if p99 crosses 1.6s. Logging watch rule and slack alert in #eng-sre too.

sasha_ops: thanks all — I'll draft the initial incident timeline and start the RCA notes.

jess_support: closing CS loop for the two reported tickets with note: workaround in place (routing to fp16). Will reopen if customers see further issues.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging. Postmortem reminder scheduled in 24h.
